decisions.reason: The single-board architecture preserves standalone USB functionality but makes the prior separate-power-board activation and main-board location descriptions obsolete.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: I was thinking, if you have time for a new project and are willing to do it, that we try to make as cheap as possible single board for this project. So everything will be on one board and from start we try to match JLCPCB Basica component (as much as possible). It will have much less connectors as there are no interboard connectors. Also if you have some idea on how to make something better/cheaper but have same functionality you can suggest. I can add it as new milestone to this project and we can agree on price. What do you think does it make sense?

value_updates.activation_condition: USB-C powers the integrated board for standalone programming when the primary AXP2101 source is unavailable
value_updates.normal_operation_source: AXP2101 DCDC1 programmed to 3.4V via I2C before the integrated-board Schottky OR-ing drop

decisions.reason: The existing message-750 MODIFY already removes the obsolete interboard alignment and cable-routing attributes and records their elimination under the integrated-board architecture.

The existing message-750 MODIFY removes the interboard connector orientation and records elimination of the interboard connector; the remaining battery and external-connector accessibility constraints can still apply unchanged.
Eliminating all interboard connectors necessarily makes the stored 5V-output and 5V_EN interboard connector routes obsolete without changing the boost-control behavior.

decisions.reason: The existing message-750 MODIFY already changes 3.3V measurement coverage from separate downstream boards to all integrated-board loads; the monitored rails and monitor placement remain valid.

The existing message-750 MODIFY already integrates the external sensor fanout, removes the interboard input connectors and obsolete total connector count, and records that interboard connectors are disabled.

The native USB data lines and programming role remain, but their interboard connector route and the condition phrased as operation without a separate power board are obsolete in a single-board design.

The existing message-750 MODIFY already relocates the panel power connector to the integrated board and replaces the interboard PWRON tap with a direct integrated-board PWRON connection.
The existing message-750 MODIFY completely records the transition to one integrated board and removes the obsolete separate-board inventory.
The existing scope change is incomplete because J_PWR_BTN still routes PWRON through the eliminated J_PWR_SIG interboard connector.
